subtitle.en: Publishing the IMGUI toolkit used by the latest OpenGL SDK examples, with a two-widget sample.
subtitle.zh: 把最新一批 OpenGL SDK 示例里用的 IMGUI 工具包放了出来，附一个两个控件的示例。

blocks.en: I just published the immediate mode user interface ([IMGUI](https://mollyrocket.com/forums/viewforum.php?f=10)) toolkit that we are using in our latest [OpenGL SDK examples](http://developer.download.nvidia.com/SDK/10.5/opengl/samples.html).
blocks.zh: 我刚把即时模式用户界面（[IMGUI](https://mollyrocket.com/forums/viewforum.php?f=10)）工具包发布了，我们最新那批 [OpenGL SDK 示例](http://developer.download.nvidia.com/SDK/10.5/opengl/samples.html)用的就是它。

blocks.en: The purpose of the SDK examples is to show how to implement certain techniques using OpenGL. We did not want to spend too much time writing UI code, and we did not want the UI code to end up occupying more space than the code dedicated to the technique we are trying to showcase. IMGUI allowed us to accomplish these goals in an elegant way.
blocks.zh: SDK 示例的目的是演示怎么用 OpenGL 实现某些技术。我们不想在写 UI 代码上花太多时间，也不想让 UI 代码占的篇幅超过我们真正要展示的那项技术。IMGUI 让我们很优雅地达到了这两个目标。

blocks.en: You can get the whole source code at the [nvidia-widgets google project](http://code.google.com/p/nvidia-widgets/), and feel free to drop by the [Molly Rocket IMGUI forums](https://mollyrocket.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=658) to share your feedback!
blocks.zh: 完整源码在 [nvidia-widgets google project](http://code.google.com/p/nvidia-widgets/)，也欢迎到 [Molly Rocket IMGUI 论坛](https://mollyrocket.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=658)来聊聊你的想法！
